posts.description: groupe-serl.fr Revenue $150 Million Groupe SERL is a French engineering and construction group founded in 1985 in Rennes, Brittany, specializing in civil and industrial construction, MEP systems, facility management and energy solutions across France. With approximately 800 to 1,000 employees and estimated revenue of 120 to 150 million euro, it operates regional offices in Nantes, Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux, Lille and Toulouse. Its services span gross construction, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire protection, lift installation and renewable energy including solar and heat pumps. The group also provides full facility management including preventive and corrective maintenance, technical building management and energy optimization. It serves office, industrial, healthcare, education, retail, hotel and logistics sectors. Its motto is Build, Maintain, Innovate, reflecting a full lifecycle approach from construction through long-term operations.

groupe-alternance.com Groupe Alternance is a French private education group founded in 2008 in Paris, offering work-study (alternance) programs across 5 schools with 10,000 plus students, 300 plus staff and 1,200 plus partner companies. Its model lets students earn a salary while their employer pays for their education, covering Bachelor, BTS and MBA programs in management, marketing, finance, HR, logistics, tourism and sport management. Key schools include ESAM, EFB, ECE, IPAC and the Institut de Management International, with campuses in Paris, Lyon, Marseille, Toulouse, Lille, Bordeaux and Strasbourg. Programs run through apprenticeship and professionalization contracts with companies covering tuition costs. Graduates receive state-recognized diplomas from Bac+2 to Bac+5. Its motto is that training should cost nothing and earn everything, positioning it as a new generation of business schools.

h2o-michel.fr huissiers-bordeaux.com SAS H2O MICHEL is a French commissaire de justice firm (public judicial officer — serving court documents, enforcing judgments, debt recovery) created in 2018 and based in Tours/Chinon, Val de Loire (Indre-et-Loire). It is led by President Alexandra Michel and operates 5 offices (Tours, Chinon, Bourgueil, Langeais, Château-la-Vallière) with a small team of 3–7 employees. Revenue grew rapidly from €223K in 2018 to €631K in 2019 (+183%), with a strong 16.4% net margin (€103.5K net profit, ROE 85.8%) — though all accounts since 2020 are filed confidentially (estimated €600K–1M today). The firm is part of H2O Réseau National, France's first national network of commissaires de justice specialized in debt recovery (group network: 160+ staff, 6 major offices). Core services: enforcement of court decisions (saisie-attribution, wage garnishment, evictions, property seizures), debt collection, legal constats, and auction sales.

sicsoe.fr zoominfo.com/c/sicsoe/359018881 SICSOE (Solution Vin Logistique) is a French wine logistics company based near Bordeaux, established in 1985. They provide comprehensive, customized logistics services for the wine industry, including winery operations, bottling, storage, and shipping. The company is recognized for its advanced technology ensuring full product traceability and its strong commitment to environmental and quality standards, including ISO 14001 certification

toutigeac.com zoominfo.com/c/vignobles-toutigeac/456813413 Vignobles Toutigeac family-run wine estate located in Targon, within the Bordeaux and Entre-Deux-Mers appellations in France. Originally an ecclesiastical property managed by monks, the estate now spans approximately 42 hectares of vineyards under the guidance of Oriane and Philippe Mazeau. The winery produces classic red and white Bordeaux wines, recognized for their smooth tannins and balanced fruit profiles, successfully blending historical tradition with modern winemaking practices
